Name: Blooming Cursors - Summer Party
Author: Obi1005
Description:
[center][img]https://i.meee.com.tw/SZikkm2.png[/img][/center]

[center][i][size=4]讓四季在你手中綻放。[/size][/i][/center]
[center][i][color=#999999][size=2]Let the four seasons bloom in your hands![/size][/color][/i][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]這套設計將讓你的游標如同捧花，成為持著花束在山谷裡奔跑的農夫吧！[/center]
[center][color=#999999]This design will make your cursor like a bouquet, become a farmer running through the valley holding a bunch of flowers![/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]這是我的第一套像素藝術設計，謹獻給一位創作了美麗繡球花游標的韓國社群創作者doran637，
他的花卉藝術是我的像素作畫啟蒙。[/center]
[center][color=#999999]This is my first pixel art design, dedicated to a Korean community creator doran637 who created a beautiful hydrangea cursor,[/color][/center]
[center][color=#999999]their floral art was my inspiration for pixel painting.[/color][/center]
[center]

也謝謝那位創作者，我在他的頁面上看見了那朵美麗的繡球花，他也為我提供了原創者的，即使我們已然難以聯絡那位創作者。[/center]
[center]若沒有他，我的像素創作之路不會發生。[/center]
[center][color=#999999]I'd also like to thank that creator. I saw that beautiful hydrangea on their page, and they also provided me with the original creator's information, even though we've since had difficulty contacting that creator.
Without them, my pixel art journey wouldn't have happened.[/color][/center]

[center][img]https://i.meee.com.tw/CbOp8mT.png[/img][/center]


一年多以前，我看見一位創作者在自己模組的展示圖中截圖到了他的繡球花游標。
[color=#999999]More than a year ago, I noticed a hydrangea cursor in one of that creator showcase screenshots. [/color]

這讓我日思夜想。
[color=#999999]I couldn't stop thinking about it. [/color]
[spoiler]
於是我在留言區裡翻找，與我一樣被其吸引的人不計其數，但我們只知道似乎已找不到原頁面。
[color=#999999]When I searched through the comments, I discovered that I wasn't alone. Many others had been captivated by it as well, but all we seemed to know was that the original page could no longer be found. [/color]

那晚，我僅依照那枚繡球花為靈感，做出了一套小花游標套組，並發訊詢問那位創作者，是否能告訴我這套游標的原作者聯繫方式，我想感謝，也想讓他知道他的藝術啟發了我。
[color=#999999]That evening, inspired only by that hydrangea cursor, I created a small floral cursor set of my own. I also reached out to that creator, hoping they might know how to contact the original creator. I wanted to thank them and let them know that their artwork had inspired me.[/color]

此後我不斷的嘗試聯繫那位原作者僅留下的聯繫方式，即使至今為止都杳無音訊。
[color=#999999]Since then, I have repeatedly tried to contact the original creator through the only contact information I could find. To this day, I have never received a reply. [/color]

而這一整年來，我陸陸續續產生靈感，我也決定讓我的四季都能有不一樣的花束作為游標。 現在我完成了，即《四季綻放》游標系列。
[color=#999999]Over the past year, new ideas continued to bloom. Eventually, I decided that each season should have its own unique bouquet, and that idea grew into what is now the [i]Blooming Seasons [/i]cursors collection. [/color]

我也將慢慢發佈與大家分享。
[color=#999999]I will be gradually releasing these cursor sets for everyone to enjoy. [/color]

請享用你在星露谷裡充滿可愛小花的時光。
[color=#999999]May your time in Stardew Valley be filled with adorable little flowers. [/color]
也將《四季綻放》，我的第一個像素作品獻給那位創作者doran637美麗的藝術。
[color=#999999]I also dedicate [i]Blooming Seasons[/i], my very first pixel art project, to [b]doran637[/b], whose creativity inspired this journey. [/color]

謝謝你閱讀至此。
[color=#999999]Thank you for reading.[/color]
祝　平安。
[color=#999999]Shalom.[/color][/spoiler]
[center][img]https://i.meee.com.tw/Xk4guBG.png[/img][/center]
[right]如果你發現了，沒錯，
我偷偷畫了拉塔恩的大盧恩。
沒什麼。我只是非常迷戀這個大塊頭。
[color=#999999]If you've noticed, then yes,
I secretly drew Radahn's Great Rune.
Nothing. I'm just very obsessed with this big guy.[/color] [/right]

Place the extracted folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder [/*]
[*]開始享用你的花花<3
Start enjoying your flowers <3 [/*]
